title: STARTEX — Friendly Fire

fields.staffing: Full shifts in Operations, Maintenance, and IT
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:50 AM on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at North Coast Regional Airport. The airport is operating under normal conditions, but a network anomaly has triggered an internal alert. All teams are to begin their roles. The Incident Command structure is now active.

status.name: IT Network
status.note: Unusual firewall rule applied; system logs show block on Retail VLAN

status.name: Access Control
status.note: Badge readers offline on Concourse B and Gate 14

status.name: Video Surveillance
status.note: All video feeds from Concourse B and Level 2 lost
